mo_ta_cong_viec:
Application Period: 28 Sep 2026 to 14 Oct 2026
Interview date: 05, 13 & 15 Oct 2026
Onboarding date: 16 Oct 2026 & 2 Nov 2026
As a Fresher Embedded Software Engineer, you will have the opportunity to:
Analyze and clarify software requirements.
Develop, integrate, and test embedded software based on defined requirements.
Support low-level and high-level software design for embedded modules.
Perform software integration and test execution.
Document development and test results.
Analyze and debug software issues when required.
Collaborate with experienced engineers and global development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
yeu_cau:
Who can apply:
Fresh graduates with a background in Electronics, Telecommunications, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Technical Skills:
Good knowledge of C/C++ programming.
Basic understanding of microcontrollers and embedded systems.
Knowledge of Python, Perl, or other scripting languages is a plus.
Basic knowledge of communication protocols and/or sensors is an advantage.
Other Skills:
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
Willingness to learn and develop technical expertise in the automotive domain.
Able to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing.
